products.title: Hardware Hoodie Sweatshirt & box of tees
products.body_html:
Includes a free 50ct box of Western Birch Golf tees. Just add the box of tees to your cart and the cost will automatically be deducted.

Heavyweight comfort meets jobsite grit. The Hardware Hoodie is printed on the Lane Seven Urban Hoodie Garment Dyed blank — a premium oversized hoodie with a washed-in vintage feel and durable heavyweight fleece construction. Designed to feel broken-in from day one, this hoodie brings together workwear energy, streetwear fit, and Western Birch golf culture in one piece. 

  • Lane Seven Urban Hoodie Garment Dyed (LS16001GD)
  • Heavyweight 10 oz fleece construction
  • Garment dyed for vintage washed appearance
  • Soft broken-in feel from first wear
  • Oversized streetwear-inspired fit
  • Durable tightly spun fleece for long-term wear
  • Double-needle stitched seams
  • Two-panel hood with no drawcords
  • Ribbed cuffs and waistband
  • Large “Swing That Hammer” back graphic
  • Minimal front chest logo hit
  • Built for cold morning rounds and late-night range sessions
  • Pigment black vintage wash finish

products.title: Hardware Tee Shirt & box of tees
products.body_html:
Includes a free 50ct box of Western Birch Golf tees. Just add the box of tees to your cart and the cost will automatically be deducted. 

The Hardware Tee is built on the legendary AS Colour Staple Tee — one of the most respected blanks in the game for its premium feel, durable construction, and everyday fit. Part of the Western Birch Hardware Collection, this tee takes inspiration from framing nails, blue-collar craftsmanship, and golfers who know how to put in work long before the first tee time. Finished with our oversized “Swing That Hammer” back graphic, this is a modern workwear-inspired golf tee built to live in. 

  • Premium AS Colour Staple Tee 
  • Midweight 5.3 oz combed cotton construction
  • Soft hand-feel with durable everyday wear
  • Regular fit with relaxed drape
  • Preshrunk to minimize shrinkage
  • Double-needle hems for added durability
  • Oversized back Hardware Collection artwork
  • Small left chest Western Birch Golf Co. logo

The Hardware Collection trucker hat keeps things simple and timeless. Featuring a custom embroidered Western Birch patch on a classic khaki trucker silhouette, this hat was designed to feel just as comfortable at the driving range as it does in the workshop or around a tailgate after the round. Clean, rugged, and built for everyday wear.

  • Classic structured trucker fit

  • Made to stand out on the tee box
